_note: Page facts for `cc settings apply|verify` (src/adapters/claudeSettings.ts): claude.ai Projects and a project's instructions editor. Data, not code: when claude.ai changes, fix it HERE (a data-file edit, no code change). Every selector entry is { value, status }; status is "unverified" until someone has seen it on the live page (read-only discovery on the HELM host), then "verified" with the date in `seen`. cc prints how many are still unverified on every run. Regex strings are case-insensitive and are matched against a control's accessible name (aria-label, else its visible text). Which controls cc may click at all is NOT decided here: CLAUDE.md rule 9 and the deny list in the adapter code bound it, so no edit of this file can widen it. There is deliberately NO 'auth' block: sign-in cookies are the claude platform's (claude.json).

hosts.guess: the only origin cc may read or click on; any other host stops the run

projectLink.guess: each project card on the list is a link to /project/<uuid>

projectName.guess: CSS selector of the name inside a card; empty = the first non-empty line of the card's text

projectPath.guess: path of a project's own page

createUrl.guess: the create-project form; empty = click createButton on the list instead

createButton.guess: the list page's create button (used only when createUrl is empty)

createNameField.value: name your project|project name|what are you working on
createNameField.guess: the name input on the create form, matched on placeholder, label or aria-label

instructionsOpen.guess: the control in the project's Instructions section that opens the editor

instructionsDialog.guess: the editor opens as a modal dialog

instructionsField.guess: the editor's text field, inside the dialog

instructionsFieldKind.guess: textarea (value) or contenteditable (innerText); decides how cc reads and writes it

instructionsSave.guess: the editor's Save/confirm button, inside the dialog

closeKey.guess: closes the editor without saving after a read (no button is clicked for that)

humanCheck.guess: copied from claude-code.json (those were seen live for claude.ai/code on 2026-10-17)

timing.guess: timeouts and waits; every poll is 500 ms or slower (CLAUDE.md rule 5)
